strictDefinition.dorm: one named shared-dorm bed, exact one-night stay, numeric nightly price explicitly stated, named currency, tax/fee status, exact dates
strictDefinition.private: one named hostel private room for exactly two guests, exact one-night stay, numeric nightly price explicitly stated, named currency, tax/fee status, exact dates
reject: multi-night totals without explicit nightly rate

decisionRule: A screen pass authorizes only a broader current inventory validation; it does not map or fit a city value. Deterministic code scales a per-bed dorm quote to two beds only after validation.
